// clock: 10 ns is deliberately slack. Sky130 at 130 nm cannot hit the 1 GHz S1 targets, and forcing it only produces buffer bloat that makes the layout less representative, not more.
// lanes: LANES=16 rather than the shipping 64: same structure, quarter the multiplier array, tractable runtime. See p4/README.md.
// util: 40% utilisation leaves the router room. The top-k network is a wide combinational cone over a 1024-bit score register and is the congestion hot spot.
// keys: LibreLane errors on unrecognised config keys. Only keys beginning with // are exempt, which is why the comments look like this.
